newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Loh & Loh in Putrajaya pact talks.
newsitem.headline: Loh & Loh in Putrajaya pact talks.

text.p: Loh & Loh Corp Bhd said it is talks for a "substantial amount" of contracts to be awarded by Putrajaya Holdings Sdn Bhd, which is overseeing construction of Malaysia's new federal administrative capital.
In a statement distributed by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Wednesday, the civil engineering firm said an announcement would be made "in due course when negotiations have been concluded".
It did not spell out the terms of the contracts. Putrajaya buildings will include the prime minister's office, home and other government offices. Putrajaya Holdings is a government-owned entity.
Loh & Loh stock was suspended from July 22, being last traded at 9.75 ringgit.
